text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner!!
A whirlwind of passions colliding!!
They burst onto the straightaway!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Like hell I'm gonna loooose!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Buena Vista!!
Buena Vistaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Engrave it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey swoops in with a ferocious charge!!
It's Journey!! It's Journey!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's a journey toward her dream!!
Dream Journey takes the lead!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Dream Journey takes first place!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Here it is---! Back-to-back Grand Prix victories!!!
Congratulations, Dream Journey!!!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap~~~!!!
That race was so crazy hype~~!!
Journey-samaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Hahaha!
I really did... get taught a lesson here...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So this is that legendary bowl passed down through the ages?
It's totally maxed out on rich broth and extra toppings, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
To think you'd even win the Arima Kinen for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You truly are... a very dutiful person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...
Are you leaving already?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Because it makes my blood boil.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't it be fine to offer your congratulations
before doing anything else?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Not needed.
What my sister seeks is for things to be like this.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Or... will you take the brunt of this surging fire yourself?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Very well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall gladly be your partner.
...For passion is welling up within me as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Is this, too, a form of change?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Journey-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations...!
That was really incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even now, deep inside me is burning hot...
and my heart is racing...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Because you competed against me,
I was able to run like this today...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the "dream," Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Journey-san—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget the "breathtaking view"
that Journey-san showed me today, either.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So... will you run with me again
sometime in the future?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ehehe— I'm so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Journey! Journey! Journey!
Journey! Journey! Journey!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...Truly."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's dreams...
feel so dazzling... and so deeply endearing...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Having achieved consecutive Grand Prix victories,
Dream Journey basks in the cheers of countless fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That figure looks more dazzling than anything, shining brighter than gold—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That part of you, at least, never changes—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone!
Thank you all so much for your support today!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Today, I have granted one of everyone's dreams.
However, my journey still continues.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Let us make a new promise right here.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"That I will continue to take you all
on a dreamlike journey—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, amid the wild cheers,
a new journey was proclaimed at Nakayama—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—...Throughout this "journey,"
I have witnessed countless changes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That change was by no means limited
solely to the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That includes changes in you... and in myself.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Now I finally understand...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "This very change is what one gains through a 'journey.'"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: To me, it is... "gold"—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —That is precisely why I wish to ask.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Did you find your "gold"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "To evoke bonds through that running, inherit the power of the Mejiro family's tradition, and earn its re-evaluation—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To those who will run in the future, she demonstrated the sheer power accumulated through her own running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It will surely
summon a new 'storm' in the future—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume named Dream Journey,
connecting the past and the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To me, and to the racing world as a whole,
she is truly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...A "single ray of gold."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ……That's just the kind of answer I'd expect from you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Without each other,
we surely never would have found our 'gold.'"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And that... surely won't ever change going forward.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Well then, shall we make up our minds soon?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: To the "journey's" next destination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —At the end of the journey, I saw a streak of gold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A long, enduring...
light stretching far into the distance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Let's chase after it and head out on our next journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together with Dream Journey.
